etsy.title: Headphones On Sign, Do Not Disturb Office Poster, Focus Time Wall Art, Work From Home Desk Decor
etsy.description:
A gentle Headphones On sign for desks and doors, asking others to message or wave instead of interrupting focused work.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Tape or frame near a desk or door as a quiet, low-pressure do-not-disturb cue.

This listing is a physical poster print, not a substitute for professional medical, therapy, or educational advice. Thank you for supporting a small, neurodivergent-run shop!

competitorNotes: 'Headphones on, don't disturb' on Etsy is mainly stickers, apparel and headphone covers; wall signs/posters for the phrase are scarce.
Door hangers pair headphone graphics with 'recording in progress' or 'do not disturb' text.
Most shared-project results (sensory room, calm corner, neurodiversity decor) are digital printables; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Amazon DND signs are flip door hangers, sliding multi-status signs, LED busy lights and desk plaques for cubicles and home offices.

research.notes: 'headphones on' is the printed title and appears in Etsy listing/market results; poster format is a gap versus stickers. Description 'Print and tape' changed to 'Tape or frame' because the buyer receives a printed poster. Listing pages were not reachable from this environment (WebFetch blocked); evidence is from search results only. No priceRange: snippets mixed digital downloads with physical signs and did not separate physical poster prices.
